shows: A picture of the dark Snowlight map of the contiguous US taken at 8:28 AM Central time on October 26, 2026: near-black land, gray state lines and city names. At this zoom the map draws no school specks. Not in the picture: Snowlight's chance of no school on Monday, October 26 is at most 1% in every one of the 18227 districts with a chance.
alt: The dark national Snowlight map, pictured on Oct 26, 2026, with state lines and city names, captioned Dev log.
tagline: Every school closing in the US on one map, coming this winter
